{{Quote|I raced against him in that race. He was one of the fastest. Incredibly quick reflexes.''"<br />"''Yeah. But not fast enough.|Anakin Skywalker speaks of Ratts Tyerell to Doby and Deland Tyerell|<ref name="JQ">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>}}
'''Ratts Tyerell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] who participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]], Tyerell had incredible reflexes, which made him an adept [[Podracing/Legends|Podracer]]. For several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he built up his reputation and became well-liked by the other regular racers. He was furious at the way fellow racer [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] found his success through cheating and vowed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] racer. However, Tyerell perished in the Boonta Eve Classic&mdash;his [[Scatalpen (Podracer)/Legends|podracer's]] accelerator jammed in the confines of the [[Laguna Caves/Legends|Laguna Caves]], causing him to crash. [[Deland Tyerell/Legends|His son]] went on to found the [[Ratts Tyerell Foundation/Legends|Ratts Tyerell Foundation]], which attempted to outlaw the sport of Podracing.

==Biography==
===Life as a podracer===
[[File:Ratts_tyerell.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Tyerell in his podracer.]]
{{Quote|Well I've got my money on that little scrapper, Ratts Tyerell. He may be small in stature, but he's got a couple of the biggest racing engines I've ever seen.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]|audio=Fode-RattsTyerell.flac|<ref name="Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
Ratts Tyerell was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] born on his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]] sometime during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DB" /> Tyerell grew up in a harsh environment, causing him to push his reflexes to the limit<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>&mdash;as a youth, he was frequently chased by the vicious creatures of his homeworld.<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> As a result of this difficult life, Aleena had extremely quick reflexes as a species, which led many of them to success on the [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] circuits.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Tyerell, too, showed a natural aptitude for Podracing, and before long, he became a regular [[Podracer/Legends|racer]] on the worlds where the sport was held.<ref name="Racer" />

Tyerell eventually acquired a large podracer from the [[Important Merchant]] to make up for his lack of height. Named after the [[Scatalpen/Legends|scatalpen]], a deadly predator native to Tyerell's homeworld, the [[Titan 2150 rocket engine/Legends|''Titan 1250 Scatalpen'']] was very fast,<ref name="PodDB">{{DB|vehicle|rattstyerellspodracer|Podracer, Ratts Tyerell's}}</ref> though its acceleration and maneuverability were not as advanced. Still, it served the Aleena racer well, and for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he slowly built up his reputation, becoming the track favorite at [[Howler Gorge/Legends|Howler Gorge]]<ref name="Racer" /> and earning the respect and friendship of his fellow racers. Tyerell was a gentleman on the track, though off of it he was thought by many to be very boastful and even a bully.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Some time during his career, he found a [[Tyerell|mate]], and together they had several children, including [[Deland Tyerell/Legends|Deland]] and [[Djulla]].<ref name="EpI" />

Tyerell was also fond of a game called [[Ratts Race]] and often played it with [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="Math">''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''</ref> The Aleena was also against any form of cheating at races, and was sickened at how [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], one of the most successful podracers of the period, had achieved his success. Tyerell sought to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Sebulba, although he was not the only racer who wanted to be rid of the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]]. Still, he never conspired with the others, preferring to keep his "gentleman" reputation intact. Instead, he had an outlaw tech specialist fit the ''Scatalpen'' with illegal weaponry, hoping to ambush Sebulba during [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY's]] [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and to win the race for himself.<ref name="NEGTC" />

===Boonta Eve Classic===
The Boonta Eve Classic was one of the most prestigious annual podraces in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; it attracted huge crowds at the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Grand Arena]] on Tatooine. The race was always the subject of much [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and cheating, and nearly all of the other racers were involved in plots with each other, hoping to snatch first place. Tyerell had plans to ridding himself of Sebulba, but he worked toward this goal alone. He lined up in his podracer in the first row of the starting grid, alongside fellow racers [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]], and his target, Sebulba. The race also saw the inclusion of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a young [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who had entered the Boonta Eve Classic despite mass ridicule directed at him by the other players.<ref name="EpI" />

[[File:Finalmoments.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Tyerell's final moments.]]
Tyerell's wife had recently given birth to another child, named [[Doby Tyerell]], but attended the race anyway along with her three other [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]. Tyerell did manage to complete one lap,<ref name="DB" /> though he had not yet been presented with an opportunity to take out Sebulba, who was far ahead. The Aleena's race, however, was cut short on his second lap, in the [[Laguna Caves/Legends|Laguna Caves]]&mdash;a tight cavern full of massive stalactites. Worried that young Anakin Skywalker would overtake him, Tyerell lost concentration as he passed through the cave;<ref name="EpI" /> meanwhile, his accelerator jammed and he was unable to gain clearance past the rocky stalactites.<ref name="DB" /> Tyerell's vehicle collided with a large rock and he died in the explosion that ensued.<ref name="EpI" /> Even if Tyerell had survived the explosion, he would have had no chance of being rescued, as the Laguna Caves were rumored to contain a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]].<ref name="E1VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

===Legacy===
Tyerell's family was devastated after his death, though it marked only the beginning of troubles to follow. Ratts Tyerell's own brother sold his daughter, Djulla, as a slave to Sebulba. His son, Deland&mdash;under the nickname "Pabs"&mdash;intended to race Sebulba for his sister's freedom on the planet [[Euceron]]. However, Sebulba was not the one racing; rather, it was the Dug's son [[Hekula]]. Meanwhile, Sebulba sabotaged the young Aleena, ruining his chances of winning. Anakin Skywalker, who had won the Boonta Eve Classic wherein Tyerell perished, had since become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and was on the planet to act as a peacekeeper. Unable to resist the temptation of podracing, he raced against Hekula. Skywalker raced in Deland's place and beat Hekula, winning Djulla's freedom.<ref name="JQ" />

Ratts Tyerell's death ultimately had a large effect on the sport of podracing.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Moved by his father's death, Deland Tyerell eventually established the [[Ratts Tyerell Foundation/Legends|Ratts Tyerell Foundation]], which was an organization devoted to making Podracing a safer sport in order to preserve the lives of those [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had wives and children. They campaigned for the sport to be outlawed all over the galaxy and were successful on many worlds, though several famous podracers spoke out against it, claiming it was an effort by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to crack down on [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] activities.<ref name="NEGAS" /> The Republic denied this, and [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], made a statement declaring that it was nonsense.<ref name="HN2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're headed for a burnout, pally!|Ratts Tyerell taunts another racer|translated=1|audio=RattsTyerell-taunt.flac|<ref name="Racer" />}}
Ratts Tyerell was of small stature compared to [[Human/Legends|Humans]], standing just under eighty centimeters tall&mdash;although he was not small for an Aleena. Tyerell had blue skin, with patches of yellow on his jaw and underarms, and a huge mouth which could open extremely wide.<ref name="DB" />

Most beings thought that Tyerell was overconfident and felt he was a bully, though he was one of the most well respected podracers of his time.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Anakin Skywalker, who raced against the Aleena in the Boonta Eva Classic of 32 BBY, thought very highly of Ratts Tyerell, describing him as one of the fastest podracers who competed at Mos Espa that day.<ref name="JQ" /> Tyerell preferred to race with honor, and loathed those who resorted to cheating in order to gain standing. However, Tyerell felt it was justified to commit crimes on the track himself if they were for the good&mdash;he decided to attempt to take out Sebulba himself in order to rid the sport of the cheating Dug.<ref name="NEGTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ratts_Concept.jpg|thumb|Concept art by [[Terryl Whitlatch]].]]
The early evolution of Ratts Tyerell can be traced via labels and dates on concept art. In his earliest published incarnation, dated [[July 16]] [[1996]], he was labeled simply as "Pod Racer - Long Head." By [[September 17]] of that year, he was known as "Amphibian," although his art still had no proper name. Sketches dated [[May 27]], [[1997]] finally bore the name "Ratts Tyerell."<ref name="e1ig">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>

Content from the [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook|''Attack of the Clones Scrapbook'']] was going to establish him as having no relation to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bogg Tyrell/Legends|Bogg Tyrell]]. However, the content was cut, and is this not confirmed [[canon]].<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1125#16098316|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-12-28|time=4:01 PM|quote=They're unrelated. Unused text for the ''Attack of the Clones Scrapbook'' had intended to point out this fact.}}</ref>

Tyerell's voice in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' was provided by [[Terence McGovern]].

Tyerell was given "Special Thanks" in the credits for the video game ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''; his name was accompanied by "RIP."<ref name="RacerRevenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>
